messages:
maria_k: Quick sync request — we need a short pulse on cross-vendor validation & marketplace timing for Gaudi / MI300 / H200/H100 variants. Can folks post blockers and safe-ish joint-announce windows? cc @aj @pete_b :eyes:

aj: Noted. Do we want one combined GA press or staggered by vendor? my gut: staggered to avoid infra pressure.

maria_k: Staggered is fine. Need to align SI integration milestones though — customers expect a single compatibility matrix from us.

pete_b: Agreed. From eng side: validation + perf regression run takes ~2 weeks per model variant if lab capacity available. Current constraint = B200 firmware on our test fleet.

sophia_r: SI teams need at least 3 business days for packaging + docs after final images. Also need marketplace listing assets from partners (logos, product copy).

nick_nvidia: NVIDIA side: H200 baseline drivers ready mid-next-month but H100 microcode patching may require extra QA. We can provide images earlier to partners if needed.

maria_k: Helpful. Can you confirm earliest vendor-provided image drops for each platform? A short one-line per vendor would be perfect.

nick_nvidia: H200: images week-of-1777777900 (tentative). H100: images + microcode ~2 weeks after that. Will ping weekly.

ben_partnerbot: NOTE: Please attach marketplace SKU IDs and compliance certs when available.

aj: For MI300 (Amp kernel), we need one extra perf sweep for long-seq gen. Expect images from partner in 10 days.

pete_b: Lab queue: I'll reserve a 2-week sweep slot if images land by next Monday. If delayed, push to week after.

sophia_r: Can we sketch tentative customer-facing timeline? I propose:
```
- Vendor images final: target +3 weeks
- Internal validation sweeps: +1 to +2 weeks
- SI packaging & doc freeze: +1 week
- Marketplace listing prep + legal review: +1 week
- Soft GA (limited customers): +1 week
- Broad GA / press: +2 weeks after soft GA
```

maria_k: That looks reasonable. Let's capture gating items per vendor (short):
- NVIDIA: H200 image, H100 microcode, logos + SKU
- AMD: MI300 perf sweep results, certs, marketplace metadata
- Habana/Gaudi: runtime ver, TF/PyTorch wheel compatibility, SI test apps

aj: Small ask — if we do staggered news, we should reserve marketplace announce slots on the calendar. Who owns calendar entries?

pete_b: I'll create the calendar placeholders after this thread.

ben_partnerbot: REMINDER: embargo windows must be set in partner portal at least 5 business days before public.

sophia_r: Ops/legal: can someone confirm embargo policy? We need to sync on PR lead times.

maria_k: @aj can loop in legal. Also, partners: please confirm any press blackout periods. We don't want conflicts.

nick_nvidia: No blackout on our side currently. Will confirm if enterprise customers request embargo.

aj: Looping in legal offline. In the meantime, action items:
- Vendors: post earliest image dates + any embargo constraints (reply here)
- Eng: reserve lab slots & confirm perf sweep plan (pete_b)
- DevRel/SI: draft integration checklist + docs timeline (sophia_r)
- Partnerships: build calendar waves + placeholder announcements (maria_k)

maria_k: Thanks all. If vendors can reply in-thread by EOD Friday, I'll assemble a short one-pager for execs. :thumbsup:

nick_nvidia: Will reply with firm dates by EOD Friday.

pete_b: Reserved tentative slots; will update if images land earlier/later.

sophia_r: Starting doc skeleton now. Will post link when ready.

ben_partnerbot: ACTION LOGGED: 1777777777 - hw-integration-pulse created.
